purpose: Receipt completion from the already observed parser invocation and tool result; no parser or test rerun

invocation.shell: PowerShell, inherited session default; no shell override was supplied
invocation.working_directory_source: Inherited environment context; no workdir override was supplied
invocation.interpreter_resolution_evidence: Earlier Get-Command python,py returned python.exe with this Source; no interpreter/path mutation was performed between that lookup and the audit invocation
invocation.interpreter_runtime_version_note: Not captured during the original invocation; no later interpreter invocation was used to infer it

observed_tool_result.output_capture_kind: The exec_command result exposes one output field, without separate stdout and stderr fields
observed_tool_result.stream_qualification: The captured output is the parser's printed result JSON and contains no additional diagnostic text. Separate stdout/stderr byte counts were not reported; stderr is therefore not independently asserted empty.
observed_tool_result.timing_qualification: wall_time_seconds is the tool-reported wall time for the exec_command call. Independent process CPU time, interpreter-only duration, and start/end timestamps were not captured.

report_generation_timestamp.source: Existing PATCH_AUDIT.json created_utc field, read during receipt completion
report_generation_timestamp.qualification: Timestamp created inside the original parser invocation when its report object was initialized; not a separately measured process start or end
